num_machines: <int> Number of machines available to process jobs.
num_jobs: <int> Number of jobs that must be assigned to machines.
cost_matrix: <list[list[int]], shape [num_machines][num_jobs]> Cost incurred when a specific job is assigned to a specific machine.
resource_matrix: <list[list[int]], shape [num_machines][num_jobs]> Amount of machine resource consumed when a specific job is assigned to a specific machine.
capacities: <list[int], length num_machines> Maximum total resource available on each machine.
